description: The EAOS design standard and its free sources (eaos/analysis/design.py): every look EAOS draws or reviews, built from pinned libraries (upstreams/toolchain.json, stage S06) and held to the same rules.
standard: Phone first: every screen is designed at 375 px wide first, then widened; nothing needs sideways scrolling.
Touch targets of at least 44 by 44 px; primary actions within thumb reach on a phone (a bottom bar for the main sections).
Both directions: layouts use logical properties (start and end, never left and right), so Arabic and English share one design.
One theme, as design tokens: colours, type scale, spacing, radii and shadows are tokens; no screen sets its own colour or font.
Light and dark from the same tokens, each with text contrast of at least 4.5:1 (WCAG AA).
Arabic text: no letter-spacing, a line height of 1.6 or more, a font made for Arabic, never a Latin font's fallback.
Fonts served from the app itself (Fontsource), only the subsets used: no third-party font request.
Components from shadcn/ui (Radix underneath: keyboard and screen-reader ready), added with its CLI, rtl true when the app speaks Arabic.
Motion that respects reduced-motion, and visible focus on everything that can be reached by keyboard.

components.rtl: set "rtl": true in components.json before adding components (or npx shadcn@latest migrate rtl)

arabic.name: Noto Sans Arabic
arabic.for: interfaces needing many weights and widths
